facilities.title: ART GALLERY
facilities.description: Throughout the hotel, carefully selected paintings and sculptures are on display. Enjoy a distinctive stay that feels like a stroll through a gallery.

facilities.title: INFINITY POOL
facilities.description: Experience peaceful relaxation in an infinity pool where sky and sea become one. Take in the clear ocean, enjoy unhurried moments, and indulge in the ultimate escape in a private cabana.

facilities.title: SIGNATURE RESTAURANT
facilities.description: Savor course menus crafted with local ingredients and seasonal flavors, served with beautiful ocean views. Experience refined dining from morning through evening.

facilities.title: SPA & WELLNESS
facilities.description: Restore balance to body and mind through wellness programs amid gentle aromas and warm lighting. Discover personalized care from skilled therapists.

facilities.title: STANDARD ROOM
facilities.description: A room where understated classic design meets natural light. Enjoy comfortable rest in a cozy setting.

facilities.title: SUITE ROOM
facilities.description: A suite with a separate, spacious living room and bedroom. Experience the finest relaxation with expansive ocean views and a private setting.
